# The status the hook writes (SandboxRules.kt and bbd/src/sandbox/identity.rs).
# The format of the cases is in README.md.
#
# line    the hook writes the file and the daemon reads it
# read    only the daemon reads these files, including the legacy format
#
# android_id=, app_list=, uri_grants= and ad_id= describe the daemon's
# expected health. The file retains the old 1/0 values and adds _health
# fields. api=, list= and boot= describe what the hook writes; now= and ack=
# override the daemon's boot and whether the revision matches respectively.

line	android_id=1\nandroid_id_health=working\napp_list=1\napp_list_health=working\nuri_grants=1\nuri_grants_health=working\nad_id=1\nad_id_health=working\napi=35\nlist=1\nboot=abc-1\n	android_id=working	app_list=working	uri_grants=working	ad_id=working	api=35	list=1	boot=abc-1
line	android_id=1\nandroid_id_health=working\napp_list=0\napp_list_health=incompatible\nuri_grants=1\nuri_grants_health=working\nad_id=0\nad_id_health=degraded\napi=35\nlist=1\nboot=abc-1\n	android_id=working	app_list=incompatible	uri_grants=working	ad_id=degraded	api=35	list=1	boot=abc-1
line	android_id=1\nandroid_id_health=working\napp_list=0\napp_list_health=incompatible\nuri_grants=1\nuri_grants_health=working\nad_id=0\nad_id_health=degraded\napi=35\nlist=0\nboot=abc-1\n	android_id=degraded	app_list=incompatible	uri_grants=degraded	ad_id=degraded	api=35	list=0	boot=abc-1
read	android_id=1\nandroid_id_health=working\napp_list=0\napp_list_health=incompatible\nuri_grants=1\nuri_grants_health=working\nad_id=0\nad_id_health=degraded\napi=35\nlist=1\nboot=abc-1\n	android_id=degraded	app_list=incompatible	uri_grants=degraded	ad_id=degraded	api=35	list=1	boot=abc-1	now=abc-1	ack=0
read	android_id=1\napp_list=0\nuri_grants=1\nad_id=1\napi=35\nlist=1\nboot=abc-1\n	android_id=working	app_list=incompatible	uri_grants=working	ad_id=working	api=35	list=1	boot=abc-1	now=abc-1
read	android_id=1\napp_list=1\napi=35\nlist=1\nboot=abc-1\n	android_id=working	app_list=working	uri_grants=incompatible	ad_id=incompatible	api=35	list=1	boot=abc-1	now=abc-1
read	android_id=1\nandroid_id_health=working\napp_list=1\napp_list_health=working\nuri_grants=1\nuri_grants_health=working\nad_id=1\nad_id_health=working\napi=35\nlist=1\nboot=abc-1\n	android_id=not_loaded	app_list=not_loaded	uri_grants=not_loaded	ad_id=not_loaded	api=35	list=1	boot=abc-1	now=abc-2
read	android_id=1\nandroid_id_health=working\napp_list=1\napp_list_health=working\nuri_grants=1\nuri_grants_health=working\nad_id=1\nad_id_health=working\napi=35\nlist=1\nboot=abc-1\n	android_id=not_loaded	app_list=not_loaded	uri_grants=not_loaded	ad_id=not_loaded	api=35	list=1	boot=abc-1	now=
read	android_id=0\napp_list=0\nuri_grants=0\nad_id=0\napi=35\nlist=1\n	android_id=not_loaded	app_list=not_loaded	uri_grants=not_loaded	ad_id=not_loaded	api=35	list=1	boot=	now=abc-1
